tonal.role: heterogeneous cognitive/runtime and research system with exact-commit composition, integration, provenance and distribution infrastructure

project.name: Tonal
project.architecture: capability-first heterogeneous runtime plus generic exact-commit composition of independent development and representation subsystems

composition_model.rule: An example is not part of a Tonal composition until an exact repository, version and immutable commit are explicitly added to the manifest and lock.

tlaloc.authority: capability development, bounded Tlaloque experiments, Behavior Lab evidence, executor qualification, CapabilityProfile production and capability lifecycle
tlaloc.role: Tonal capability foundry and Behavior Lab; not Tonal runtime authority

origami.authority: Origami representation, carrier, addressing, virtual-memory and profile semantics plus Origami-specific promotion evidence

ownership.component_semantics: owned only by each component/target repository
ownership.development_artifact_authority: development tool until accepted under the consuming system/target contract
ownership.shponglese_semantic_authority: tonal architecture / future explicit Shponglese specification, independent of physical codec

notes: Tlaloc and Origami remain independently usable and authoritative for their own contracts.
Tonal runtime authority covers goal intake, workflow/DAG execution, capability selection, scheduling, Blackboard state, accounting, verification coordination and final workflow results.
Parrot is one probabilistic Tlaloque/capability and has no privileged system-level authority.
Tlaloc develops and qualifies capabilities; Tonal decides when and how to use them at runtime.
Origami may provide representation, carrier, addressing or memory services but is not required for Tonal correctness and does not own Shponglese semantics.
The historical composition layer remains exact-commit reproducibility infrastructure inside the larger Tonal system.
A Tonal verification proves the declared composition is reproducible and its configured checks pass. It does not promote Origami semantics, visual profiles or model capabilities.
A Tonal composition references exact commits, never floating branches.

The current composition includes the failure-driven Native semantic regression tooling in Tlaloc and the matching semantic-first correction in the pinned Origami revision; this composition does not claim held-out VLM success.

As of 2026-09-04 the Tlaloc pin is alpha.21 commit 6ee225a (TLALOC_T1_QUALIFIED_EXECUTOR_COMMIT): additive on the frozen Phase P/H baseline 445b18c. It adds tlaloquekit, deterministic capabilities and the R1-aware Parrot Tlaloque while preserving CapabilityProfile R1.
T1 remains frozen. Architecture R2 may provide compatibility interfaces around T1 but does not change T1 corpus, workflows, accounting, arms or preregistered evaluation semantics.

snapshot.contents: locked components plus Tonal runtime, current Architecture R2 authority documents, composition metadata and shared skills
